question: How much of Luxembourg's trade went both ways in the same CN8 product, every five years from 2005 to 2025?

limitations.message: CN8 and HS6 codes change over time, so series longer than 3 years at this level may break. HS4 or HS2 give a stable series.
Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.
3.6 % of this value is confidential at full product detail (masked codes); it is shown as a separate 'Confidential' slice, never dropped.

sql:
WITH rows AS (
  SELECT
    year AS period,
    cn8 AS key,
    flow,
    cn8 LIKE '%X%' AS masked,
    value_eur
  FROM v_lu_trade
  WHERE
    period >= CAST('2005-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND period < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND (
      year - 2005
    ) % 5 = 0
), totals AS (
  SELECT
    period,
    SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
      flow = 'export') AS x_total,
    SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
      flow = 'import') AS m_total,
    COALESCE(SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
      masked), 0) AS confidential
  FROM rows
  GROUP BY
    period
), by_key AS (
  SELECT
    period,
    key,
    COALESCE(SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
      flow = 'export'), 0) AS x,
    COALESCE(SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
      flow = 'import'), 0) AS m
  FROM rows
  WHERE
    NOT masked
  GROUP BY
    period,
    key
)
SELECT
  b.period,
  100 * SUM(b.x + b.m - ABS(b.x - b.m)) / SUM(b.x + b.m) AS value,
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  ARG_MAX(b.key, LEAST(b.x, b.m)) AS top_key,
  ARG_MAX(b.x, LEAST(b.x, b.m)) AS top_export,
  ARG_MAX(b.m, LEAST(b.x, b.m)) AS top_import,
  ANY_VALUE(t.x_total) AS x_total,
  ANY_VALUE(t.m_total) AS m_total,
  ANY_VALUE(t.confidential) AS confidential
FROM by_key AS b
JOIN totals AS t
  USING (period)
GROUP BY
  b.period
ORDER BY
  b.period
LIMIT 10000
title: Two-way trade 2025: 39.1 % (CN8 product level)

main.top_label: Machinery for working rubber or plastics…

insight: In 2025, 39.1% of Luxembourg's trade was two-way at the CN8 product level, meaning goods were both exported and imported in the same product category.
The highest share of two-way trade was 46.5% in 2005, while the lowest was 37.3% in 2020.
The largest same-product two-way trade shifted from Computers in 2005 to Telephone sets in most other years, with exports and imports varying accordingly.
Two-way trade shares fluctuated over the years, with a notable dip in 2020 coinciding with the COVID-19 period.
The data excludes some confidential product codes and uses nominal euros, which means values are not adjusted for price changes and product classifications may have changed over time.

two-way trade = Grubel-Lloyd index per product code: 100 × (1 − |exports − imports| / (exports + imports)); 100 = exported and imported in equal amounts, 0 = one way only; for all trade, the matched part Σ(X + M − |X − M|) / Σ(X + M) over every CN8 code (CN8 products); codes masked at that level (confidential) are left out of the index
